This topic is part of the OCR GCSE Economics specification.

International Trade and the Global Economy appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet International Trade and the Global Economy in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The OCR board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with International Trade and the Global Economy.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
